title: E-commerce product photography: 10 foolproof tips for creating a great-selling product photo!
metaTitle: E-commerce product photo: 10 tips for an effective photo!
description: 10 foolproof e-commerce product photography tips for creating the best-selling e-commerce product photo and boosting your online sales!
author: Laurent Wainberg
content:
You are looking to increase sales of your site? La quality of your visuals can play a decisive role. One Well thought-out product photo does not just present an article: she returns it desirable, clear and incurring.

Here it is 10 proven tips to improve your e-commerce visuals, regardless of your sector or your level of experience in photography.

1. Respect the main principles of packshot photography in your e-commerce product photos

‍

‍

For any e-commerce product photo, whether in the furniture sector or other, it is essential to respect the best practices of packshot photography, including here are some of the main principles:

  • Represent faithfully the product, without useless contrivances
  • Avoid deceptive retouching : a customer disappointed in reality is not a loyal customer
  • Use a neutral white background to focus attention on the product
  • mastering The lighting With a neutral color temperature to guarantee a faithful return

If you want to know more, we invite you to read our Complete guide to packshot photography, a series of articles that we have written for beginners and less beginners. These articles cover all the technical aspects that are essential for creating quality product photos. You will also find practical tips to improve your photos and thus boost your sales.

2. Minimum 2 or 3 images per product

Online shoppers need clear and accurate information about the products they want to buy. To do this, It is recommended to have at least two or three images per product. By providing multiple photos, you also show that you have total confidence in your product. In this way, you prove to your customers that you are transparent and that you have nothing to hide.

This transparency reassures buyers, who feel more confident when they have access to more information. In short: the more product photos you have, the more likely you are to gain the trust of your customers!

3. Remember to show your product from multiple perspectives

‍

‍

Since your customers can't touch or test products online, it's essential to show your product from different angles, so that the customer can get a clear idea of it. This includes the technical aspects of the product, but also the design, finishes and specific details. One 360 degree animation can also bring real added value to your product sheet!

4. Zoom in on the details in your e-commerce product photos

‍

‍

Some products, especially those with complex details, require more work to provide consumers with a complete view. So do not hesitate to make close-up views of some details, as if to show more closely the fabric of a garment or the delicate carvings on a pendant. The more details you can show the better.

Zooming in on these details also allows customers to better understand the quality of your product. For example, by showing the stitching of a garment, customers can see that the product is well-constructed and durable. This can justify a higher price and convince customers that it's worth it.

5. Incorporate one or more lifestyle photos

‍

‍

Customers often need to see the product in action and understand how it can improve their lives before making a purchase. That's where the lifestyle photography intervenes. This type of photo highlights the product in a very specific environment, in order to bring it to life and show it in a situation that could be real.

With lifestyle photography, your customers can thus visualize how their lives will be once they have purchased the product. This helps them to project themselves and to consider the product as already part of their daily lives. Exposing your product in a real context also allows you to highlight its features and benefits. It's an opportunity to highlight the issues the product solves and convince customers to buy it.

6. Show how the product works or installs

As an extension of lifestyle photographs, Another idea to incorporate into your e-commerce product photos Is of Show how the product is installed if it is not intuitive, or How does the product work afterwards. It is in fact completely possible to create a tutorial in the form of a diagram or an image montage to be integrated directly into your product sheet.

By showing how your product works or is installed, you will offer an optimal shopping experience to your customers, reassure them and increase your chances of selling.

7. Inform about the dimensions of your product

On the internet, our perception can quickly be misleading: We can imagine a product bigger or smaller than it really is for example, without the seller's intentions being initially misleading. It is simply difficult to visualize the real dimensions of a product that you only see in images.

This is why it is essential to give clear indications as to the size of a product. You can do this in several ways:

  • in a lifestyle photograph by placing it next to a model or an everyday object,
  • thanks to a diagram representing its exact dimensions,
  • using a size chart if you offer multiple options.

Giving this type of clear information to your customers will also avoid a lot of returns and complaints.

8. Optimize your e-commerce product photos for the web

‍

‍

Have you ever visited an e-commerce site and waited forever for product images to load? This is not only annoying for potential customers, it can also hurt your business.

However, this is a problem that can easily be solved, it is often enough tooptimize and compress product photos for your e-commerce. By reducing the size of these files, you not only improve the loading speed of your site, but you can also save storage space for your host. This image optimization should not be taken lightly: it can considerably improve the user experience and thus increase your conversion rate.

The JPEG format is the most commonly used image format on the web because it offers good image quality while being easy to compress. You can also optimize your product photos for your e-commerce directly on a retouching software like Photoshop, or you can also use free online tools such as TinyPNG.

Have images with the right dimensions is also important for optimizing your website. An image that is too big will take longer to load than an image that is the right size. Check the dimensions of your images before uploading them to make sure they are suitable for your website.

9. Use them to boost your natural referencing (SEO)

Having photos of selling products is one thing, but having a e-commerce site that attracts many visitors from the search engines, it's even better!

However, the e-commerce product photo that you are looking to optimize can also help you bring more customers to your site, thanks to natural referencing or SEO (Search Engine Optimization) in English. In fact, your images can also have a significant impact on SEO of your site.Here's how to use your product photos to boost your SEO:

  • Please fill in the Image alt tag by describing what it represents and placing relevant keywords in it. Google uses these descriptions to understand the content and context of the image.
  • Rename your images Descriptively, it will also make it easier for search engines to index them.
  • Download a Sitemap of your images to allow search engines to find them easily and thus increase your chances of ranking (many SEO plugins on Wordpress, such as YoastSEO or Rank Math SEO, allow you to do it easily).
  • Optimize the size of your images, as we told you in our previous point (the loading speed of your pages is a crucial factor for Google!).

10. Choose quality equipment

‍

‍

Last but not least: The quality of your product photos is absolutely essential. Indeed, the first thing that online shoppers notice is the quality of your visuals. If your photos aren't of professional quality, you risk losing sales. It is therefore imperative touse quality equipment to take your photos.

You have at the very least need a good camera and quality lighting with a neutral white background. However, if you are looking for the best in packshot photography, we recommend investing in a automated photo studio. This type of studio guarantees you a extremely high quality standard, all with disconcerting ease. With an automated photo studio, you can produce professional quality e-commerce product photos in just a few minutes. This material is designed to make the easy, fast and accessible photo shooting for everyone.

Even if you don't have any special photography skills, you can create flawless product photos. With an automated photo studio, you can easily adjust lighting, focus, and color settings. In addition, the integrated retouching software allows you to correct small imperfections that may remain, while providing you with images optimized and ready to publish on your e-commerce site. So all you have to do is put these 10 tips into practice to boost your online sales.

Remember that the quality of your photos is essential to make Internet users want to buy your products, so do not hesitate to consult our A more in-depth guide to packshot photography or at Contact us if you want to go further!
